subLocations.name: East Gate
subLocations.lore: The '''East Gate''' or '''Eastgate''' that led to the road north of [[Suzail]] – [[Calantar's Way]].

subLocations.name: Horngate
subLocations.lore: The northwestern gate of [[Suzail]] and the beginning of the [[Way of the Dragon]].

subLocations.name: Field-Gates
subLocations.lore: [[Suzail]]'s western gates that led to a small trail between the [[Stormhorns]] and the [[Dragonmere]].

subLocations.name: The Caskhouse
subLocations.lore: The guildhall of the [[Brewers and Cheesemakers Guild]], above the tavern in the same building.

subLocations.name: Hardshutters House
subLocations.lore: The guildhall of the the [[Roofers, Thatchers, and Glaziers Guild]].
